0.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZPYANDIHTALK_00847_PYANDIH_000_000
0.description: We've had no word from the guildmaster since he left for Kugane. I do hope he hasn't gotten lost...or worse.

1.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZPYANDIHTALK_00847_PYANDIH_000_010
1.description: I have everything under control here, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. It sounds like Martyn's the one who really needs your help right now.

2.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZPYANDIHTALK_00847_PYANDIH_000_020
2.description: I don't care how good this Gogo thinks he is, no paltry imitator stands a chance against you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

4.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZPYANDIHTALK_00847_PYANDIH_000_040
4.description: Still no word from Martyn, but never fear─it shouldn't be long before he's found a prospective rival for you.

5.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZPYANDIHTALK_00847_PYANDIH_000_050
5.description: I can only imagine what Martyn is up to in Limsa, but you'll look after him, won't you?

6.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZPYANDIHTALK_00847_PYANDIH_000_060
6.description: The Arcanists' Guild? He wasn't offering more of his private lessons again, was he? Given the opportunity to flaunt his knowledge, the man simply can't help himself.

7.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZPYANDIHTALK_00847_PYANDIH_000_070
7.description: Martyn said he has a good feeling about Gridania. I certainly hope he's right.

8.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZPYANDIHTALK_00847_PYANDIH_000_080
8.description: I heard Martyn was actually after a bounty, is that right? Somehow I'm not surprised.

9.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZPYANDIHTALK_00847_PYANDIH_000_090
9.description: He wasn't ruffling any feathers at the stables, was he? Surely not...

10.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZPYANDIHTALK_00847_PYANDIH_000_100
10.description: To be honest, it's hard to picture Martyn as a villain, even if he's only acting.

11.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZPYANDIHTALK_00847_PYANDIH_000_110
11.description: By the sounds of it, Royse has afforded Martyn more than an unfair advantage, so don't worry about holding back.

12.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZPYANDIHTALK_00847_PYANDIH_000_120
12.description: You were absolutely brilliant, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I can scarcely remember the last time the Celestium was so lively.
